name: English Opening — Symmetrical
description: After 1.c4 c5, both sides develop symmetrically in the Symmetrical English. White fianchettoes the king's bishop and exchanges on d5; Black answers with the modern 6...Nc7 retreat and the central 7...e5. The game revolves around White's d4 break and the battle for the d4 square.

lines.name: English Opening — Symmetrical
lines.description: After 1.c4 c5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nc3 Nc6 4.g3 d5 5.cxd5 Nxd5 6.Bg2, Black retreats 6...Nc7 — the modern main line — and claims the center with 7...e5. White restrains with 8.d3 and Black develops 8...Be7. The battle for d4 defines the middlegame.
